headline: Disentangled models predict perturbation responses while OT couples multimodal dynamics
label: Single Cell Perturbation And Dynamics
summary: Several new perturbation predictors and optimal-transport or multimodal frameworks target counterfactual responses and coupled chromatin–expression dynamics.
synthesis: The dominant thread is single-cell perturbation response prediction via factorized latent structure. scDisentangle decomposes expression into attributes plus sequential residuals to generate identity-preserving counterfactuals. PertVI separates mitotic phase, cell state, batch and treatment effects. scBIG++ predicts full-gene responses to genetic and chemical perturbations using gene-module clustering. LingoCell links single-cell and spatial transcriptomics with language for in silico perturbation. A second thread uses optimal transport and multimodal coupling to resolve regulatory dynamics. COATI applies unbalanced synchronized OT to infer coupled scRNA and scATAC trajectories across held-out stages. SPECHTacle combines Waddington-OT with Shannon entropy to flag preferentially altered populations. spOT-NMF uses OT-based NMF for reference-free spatial deconvolution and niche inference. scHiR jointly embeds scRNA-seq and scHi-C, and scDORI infers enhancer-driven GRNs from glioblastoma multiome data. Sample-level embedding (scSLIDE), TCR–phenotype inference (TCRi), interpretable contrastive EMT programs (scCont) and spatial CNA benchmarking (OncoSpot) are adjacent rather than core to this thread.
